compose_gtn_graphs: compose two GTN graphs together using gtn.compose to chain transducer automata
score_graph_forward: compute the forward score of a GTN graph using gtn.forward_score for log-sum-exp
decode_viterbi_path: find the best path through a GTN graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
concatenate_gtn_graphs: concatenate multiple GTN graphs in sequence using gtn.concat to build longer automata
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph using gtn.remove to simplify the automaton
